config.name: host.check.interval
config.description: the interval to check a failure host, in seconds

config.name: host.check.maxAttempts
config.description: the max attempts before judging a host as failure

config.name: host.check.successInterval
config.description: the interval to check a host if the host is judged as success, in seconds

config.name: host.check.successTimes
config.description: the max success check before judging a host as success

config.name: host.check.successRatio
config.description: the ratio that host checker must succeed to judge a host as live

config.name: host.selfFencer.interval
config.description: the interval the self-fencer checks health status, in seconds

config.name: host.selfFencer.maxAttempts
config.description: the max attempts the self-fencer tries before judging the host as networking dead

config.name: neverStopVm.retry.delay
config.description: the delay HA does the next try for a never-stop VM if the previous HA failed, in seconds

config.name: host.selfFencer.storageChecker.timeout
config.description: the timeout self-fencer check connectivity of the primary storage, in seconds

config.name: neverStopVm.scan.interval
config.description: the interval to check a failure NeverStop vm, in seconds

config.name: neverStopVm.notification.times
config.description: send notification when never stop vm gc executed times over this

config.name: neverStopVm.gc.maxRetryIntervalTime
config.description: NeverStopVmGC max retry interval time secs

config.name: self.fencer.strategy
config.description: Self fencer strategy. when set to Permissive, self fencer do not kill the vm when storage fails and also do not ha start the vm to any other host. When this strategy set to Force, self fencer do kill the vms and management node will start the vm on suitable host

config.name: allow.slibing.cross.clusters
config.description: Allow the use of other hosts with the same storage but different clusters to check if the target host is still connected.

config.name: vm.ha.strategy
config.description: VmInstance fencer strategy. this value will override the self.fencer.strategy for special case

config.name: vm.ha.level
config.description: The default High-Availability (HA) state of a newly created VM

config.name: notification.timeliness
config.description: Timeliness of HA notification. Configuration value should between -1 and 5. VM HA process will be notified to system endpoint, Negative value means notification disabled. The lower the value, the more promptly notify. The higher the value, the more expired notification will be ignored.
